Made assistant budgeted image IDs component-, slot-, and fingerprint-specific so a replaced payload transmits its bytes rather than reusing an already-resident image at that position. Tool/native assistant slot namespaces remain distinct.

Tool conversions acquire their retirement barrier and publish cached results before display construction. Both PNG conversions and upstream figure raster work participate in pending retirement; completion preserves version invalidation and repaint error handling.
Preserved PNG-preferred notebook MIME selection in eval/py/display.ts.

Preserved original operator text, including explicitly empty displayText, across transcript construction, editable drafts, outline labels, session history, tree search/native/ANSI rows, and whole-turn/block copying.
